answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with network-anchored proof-of-presence: each identity must hold one verifiable network address. First, register a stable public endpoint and stake 1,500 POA. Second, three peers ping it from three continents and triangulate latency, fixing its position like quartz in rock. Third, re-check weekly — drift over 40 ms freezes the account. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 real endpoints in separate networks, $620,000 in servers and bonds, and 90 days of clean uptime. A fake tide cannot flood a harbor whose every ship is anchored and charted. - Jowy
